wikidot5e:spell:flaming-sphere.effectSummary: Create a 5-foot-diameter fiery sphere in an unoccupied space within range. A creature ending its turn within 5 feet makes a Dexterity save, taking 2d6 fire damage on a failure or half on a success. As a bonus action, move the sphere up to 30 feet; if you ram it into a creature, that creature makes the save and the sphere stops for the turn. The sphere can move over barriers up to 5 feet high and jump pits up to 10 feet wide, ignites unattended flammable objects, and sheds bright light for 20 feet and dim light for another 20. Each slot level above 2nd adds 1d6 damage.

wikidot5e:spell:flesh-to-stone.effectSummary: One visible flesh-bodied creature in range makes a Constitution save. On a failure it is restrained as it begins turning to stone. At the end of each of its turns while restrained it repeats the save; three successes end the spell, while three failures petrify it for the duration, with successes and failures tracked until either reaches three. If physically broken while petrified, it retains corresponding deformities if restored. If you maintain concentration for the full minute, the petrification lasts until removed.

wikidot5e:spell:flock-of-familiars.effectSummary: Temporarily summon three familiars using find familiar's rules and form options; all must be celestials, fey, or fiends of the same chosen type. If you already have a familiar from find familiar or similar means, summon one fewer. These familiars can communicate telepathically with you and share their visual or auditory senses while within 1 mile. A familiar can deliver a touch-range spell normally, but only one familiar can deliver a touch spell per turn. Each slot level above 2nd summons one additional familiar.

wikidot5e:spell:fly.effectSummary: A willing creature you touch gains a 60-foot flying speed for the duration. When the spell ends, it falls if still aloft unless it can stop the fall. Each slot level above 3rd lets you target one additional creature.

wikidot5e:spell:fog-cloud.effectSummary: Create a 20-foot-radius sphere of fog centered on a point within range. It spreads around corners and heavily obscures its area until the spell ends or a wind of at least 10 miles per hour disperses it. Each slot level above 1st increases the radius by 20 feet.

wikidot5e:spell:forbiddance.effectSummary: Ward up to 40,000 square feet of floor space and 30 feet above it for 1 day. Creatures cannot teleport into the area, enter it through portals, or access it by planar travel through the Astral Plane, Ethereal Plane, Feywild, Shadowfell, plane shift, or similar means. Choose any of celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead; a chosen creature entering for the first time on a turn or starting its turn there takes 5d10 radiant or necrotic damage, chosen when cast. You may set a password whose speaker takes no damage upon entering. The area cannot overlap another forbiddance. Casting it in the same place every day for 30 days makes it last until dispelled, consuming the material components on the final casting.

wikidot5e:spell:forcecage.effectSummary: Create an immobile invisible force prison as either a cage up to 20 feet per side with 1/2-inch bars spaced 1/2 inch apart, or a solid box up to 10 feet per side that blocks matter and spells. Creatures wholly inside are trapped; creatures only partly inside or too large to fit are pushed outward until completely outside. A trapped creature cannot leave by nonmagical means. To escape by teleportation or interplanar travel, it first makes a Charisma save; on a failure the attempted spell or effect is wasted. The prison also extends into the Ethereal Plane, blocking ethereal travel, and cannot be dispelled by dispel magic.

wikidot5e:spell:foresight.effectSummary: For 8 hours, a willing creature you touch cannot be surprised and has advantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws, while attacks against it have disadvantage. The spell ends immediately if you cast foresight again before its duration expires.

wikidot5e:spell:fortunes-favor.effectSummary: Give yourself or one willing visible creature latent luck for 1 hour. Before the spell ends, when that creature makes an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, it can end the spell on itself to roll one additional d20 and choose which d20 to use. Alternatively, when an attack is made against it, it can end the spell to roll a d20 and choose between its roll and the attacker's roll. If the original roll had advantage or disadvantage, the extra d20 is rolled after that has been resolved. Each slot level above 2nd lets you target one additional creature.

wikidot5e:spell:freedom-of-movement.effectSummary: For 1 hour, a willing creature you touch ignores difficult terrain; spells and other magical effects cannot reduce its speed or make it paralyzed or restrained. It can spend 5 feet of movement to automatically escape nonmagical restraints such as manacles or a grapple. Being underwater imposes no penalties on its movement or attacks.
